ideas.pitch: An augmented reality visualization tool for surgeons and medical trainees to project 3D DICOM scans onto physical manikins or patients for pre-operative planning.
ideas.problem_statement: Explore the potential of immersive technologies to transform healthcare and industry.
ideas.title: MediSurg AR - Collaborative Surgical Planning
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the high-value healthcare domain with a tangible real-world application solves the judges' demand for meaningful real-world impact.

ideas.pitch: A WebXR and mobile AR experience that reconstructs demolished or decayed historical landmarks in their exact real-world GPS locations with interactive historical audio tours.
ideas.problem_statement: Explore the potential of immersive technologies to transform tourism and education.
ideas.title: EcoTour XR - Immersive Heritage Restoration
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines geolocation APIs with lightweight AR, making it easy to demo live via video or mobile browser during the grand finale.

ideas.pitch: A VR hazard-detection simulator for high-voltage electricians that trains them on emergency protocols in a gamified virtual substation.
ideas.problem_statement: Explore the potential of immersive technologies to transform industry and education.
ideas.title: SkillSim VR - Industrial Safety Training Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles enterprise safety training budgets, a major talking point for industry adoption of VR.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight computer vision utility that extracts body landmarks via webcam or phone camera to drive 3D avatars in real-time for virtual classrooms.
ideas.problem_statement: Explore the potential of immersive technologies to transform education and gaming.
ideas.title: PoseStream AR - Real-time Motion Capture Controller
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages difficult computer vision and pose estimation engineering, matching the technical depth seen in past hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An immersive spatial computing vocabulary builder that places interactive 3D objects with native audio labels around the user's immediate physical room.
ideas.problem_statement: Explore the potential of immersive technologies to transform education.
ideas.title: LinguaSpace VisionOS - Spatial Language Immersion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors previous hackathon winners built for modern spatial computing paradigms with high user experience focus.
